items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: oh that's why do you know that's why I play as heavy as I do I heard him play and I said to myself that this every time I play I'm play hard like that man did

ctx.x: they didn't care how you played
yes they did well after I heard Jelly play naturally I played loud and that's one reason why they preferred me to a lot of the men because they said well Lil will support you

items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mitchell was saying Jelly Roll used to rehearse quite a bit for his records sometimes. Two or three. Just one rehearsal for that.

ctx.x: I don't remember rehearsing. We rehearsed in the studio.
